question:
Among the following patients who have not responded to conservative treatment, for which one would
a diaphyseal fifth metatarsal osteotomy be the most appropriate surgical intervention? Answer
Choices: (A) 29-year-old woman with prominent lateral condyle of her 5th metatarsal head, without
bowing of the metatarsal and with normal 4-5 intermetatarsal angle (B) 48-year-old woman with a
tailor's bunion and normal 4-5 intermetatarsal angle (C) 54-year-old woman with a widened 4-5
intermetatarsal angle and a lateral prominence of the 5th metatarsal head (D) 47-year-old woman with
fifth toe contracture and normal metatarsal alignment (E) 45-year-old man with a cavovarus foot
deformity and lateral overload of the 5th metatarsal (F) 50-year-old woman with a physiologic bow to
the 5th metatarsal and a lateral prominence of the 5th metatarsal head (G) 49-year-old woman with fifth
metatarsal bursitis and normal intermetatarsal angle (H) 55-year-old man with fifth
metatarsophalangeal joint arthritis and normal alignment (I) 58-year-old man with fifth metatarsal head
plantar callosity and normal alignment (J) 62-year-old woman with an increased 1-5 intermetatarsal
angle and bunionette deformity
 A. 58-year-old man with fifth metatarsal head plantar callosity and normal alignment
B. 45-year-old man with a cavovarus foot deformity and lateral overload of the 5th metatarsal
C. 50-year-old woman with a physiologic bow to the 5th metatarsal and a lateral prominence of the
5th metatarsal head
D. 62-year-old woman with an increased 1-5 intermetatarsal angle and bunionette deformity
E. 54-year-old woman with a widened 4-5 intermetatarsal angle and a lateral prominence of the 5th
metatarsal head
F. 55-year-old man with fifth metatarsophalangeal joint arthritis and normal alignment
G. 49-year-old woman with fifth metatarsal bursitis and normal intermetatarsal angle
H. 35-year-old woman with prominent lateral condyle of her 5th metatarsal head, without bowing of
the metatarsal and with normal 4-5 intermetatarsal angle
I. 48-year-old woman with a tailor's bunion and normal 4-5 intermetatarsal angle
J. 47-year-old woman with fifth toe contracture and normal metatarsal alignment
